title: Spreadsheet
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Creating page/screen structures to meet the requirements of an audience and/or task specification/ house style, including page orientation, page size, fit to page, margins, and header and footer
Creating/editing spreadsheet structures, including insert rows and columns, delete rows and columns, hide rows and columns, resize rows and columns, and merge cells
Controlling data input using validation techniques
Protecting cells and their content, including cells, rows, columns, worksheets, and workbooks
Freezing and unfreezing panes and windows
Creating and using formulas that include/contain addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and indices
Using absolute, relative and mixed referencing to replicate formulas

Using functions that perform calculations, count the number of cells that meet a criterion, look up data, make decisions based on certain criteria, insert, extract and calculate with date and time, extract numeric values from strings, concatenate strings, test cell contents, extract characters from strings, apply conditional formulas, perform error trapping, insert nested functions, and rotate data from columns to rows or vice versa
Using appropriate input and error messages
Formatting cells, including date and time, text, numeric, currency, percentage, fractions, text orientation, and alignment
Formatting cell emphasis, including size, style, color, shading, merge, borders, comments, and conditional formatting
Appreciation of the spreadsheet requirements, purpose and use for a variety of audiences, including people from different age groups and with different specialisms
Testing a spreadsheet structure
Testing data
Extracting data
Sorting data
Summarising and displaying data
Importing and exporting data
Creating a graph or chart appropriate to a specific purpose
Apply chart formatting
